# Third-party source

Borrowed source is isolated by project and provenance. Do not paste upstream code into unrelated engine modules. Each imported source must have an accompanying notice with the upstream project, exact commit, original path, copyright, license, modifications, and Meridian destination.

Renderer donor policy and records live under [provenance](provenance/README.md).
The directory initially contains policy only; absence of a donor record means no
donor lineage may be claimed.
